payload.claim: The spec's only non-test touched file, saffron/cell/session.py, matches the elevate_on pattern saffron/cell/** in .saffron/policy.yaml, so effective_risk auto-elevates this task to risk: elevated regardless of the spec's frontmatter (which declares no risk field, defaulting to standard). This makes the size gate blocking rather than advisory per DESIGN.md's §5.4/§5.6 rule. This has no practical effect since the spec's own Size note already measured 50 changed tokens (643 including tests) comfortably under the bug ceiling of 1300, but the operator should know this task runs elevated by construction rather than by declaration.
